description: This file defines a utility class SpeedCalculator for computing vehicle speed and RPM based on engine parameters, unit settings, and ratios. It provides static methods to calculate mph, kph, and rpm, and references external constants for unit conversions.

classes.name: SpeedCalculator
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to calculate vehicle speed (mph, kph) and engine RPM from input parameters, considering unit systems.

methods.name: calculateMph
methods.description: Calculates speed in miles per hour from engine RPM and gear ratio.

methods.name: calculateKph
methods.description: Calculates speed in kilometers per hour by converting mph with a unit conversion factor.

methods.name: calculateRpm
methods.description: Calculates engine RPM from vehicle speed, gear ratio, and unit system (imperial or metric).
